text: Absolutely! Introducing a plant-based menu at the cafeteria is an excellent idea. Evidence A highlights that the dietitian-reviewed rotation aligns perfectly with all nutritional requirements, ensuring a healthy dining experience for everyone. Additionally, Evidences B and D emphasize the unique aspect of having a live fermentation station, making this menu stand out as innovative and cutting-edge. Moreover, seasonal produce contracts save on costs while also maintaining high-quality fresh options throughout the year, further enhancing the value proposition. Lastly, from evidence C, we see that these improvements will be covered through seasonal cost savings within one year. This combination ensures not only health but also economic sustainability, making it clear why introducing a plant-based menu should definitely happen.
